name: AK23CA - Desktop Indoor Air Quality Monitor (CO2, TVOC, HCHO, PM1.0, PM2.5, PM10, Temperature, Humidity, AQI), App Connected
highlights: Bluetooth History at the Base Price — The connectivity tier without the usual premium — this configuration carries app logging at the same price as the standard AK23.
Trends Are Where the Answer Is — A morning CO₂ figure tells you the room was stuffy. The overnight curve tells you the ventilation was off between 2 and 6 a.m. Only one of those is actionable.
Eight Parameters Plus the Index — Full particulate split and AQI display alongside the wireless log.
2500 mAh, Six Hours — Four-hour charge, 256 g — Bluetooth running does not shorten the figure.
The Value Configuration of the AK23 Range — If a customer wants app connectivity and price matters more than sensor tier, this is the specification to lead with.
